Shortcut Trick\n

The sum of the three 60° sectors at the vertices of an equilateral triangle forms exactly one semicircle.

\n

Required Area = Area of Equilateral Triangle − Area of Semicircle

\n

Required Area = [(√3 ÷ 4) × side2] − [(1 ÷ 2) × π × radius2]

\n

Required Area = [(√3 ÷ 4) × 282] − [(1 ÷ 2) × (22 ÷ 7) × 142]

\n

Required Area = (196 × 1.73) − 308 = 339.08 − 308 = 31.08 cm2

\n

∴ The correct answer is 31.08 cm2.

\n

Alternate Method

\n\n

Given:

\n

Side of the equilateral triangle, a = 28 cm

\n

Radius of the circle, r = a ÷ 2 = 14 cm

\n

Formula Used:

\n

Area of an equilateral triangle = (√3 ÷ 4) × a2

\n

Area of a sector of angle θ = (θ ÷ 360°) × πr2

\n

Calculation:

\n

⇒ Area of the equilateral triangle = (√3 ÷ 4) × 282

\n

⇒ Area of triangle = (√3 ÷ 4) × 784 = 196√3 cm2

\n

⇒ Taking √3 ≈ 1.73, Area = 196 × 1.73 = 339.08 cm2

\n

⇒ The triangle has three identical sectors, each with a central angle of 60°.

\n

⇒ Total area of 3 sectors = 3 × (60° ÷ 360°) × π × 142

\n

⇒ Total sector area = 3 × (1 ÷ 6) × (22 ÷ 7) × 196

\n

⇒ Total sector area = (1 ÷ 2) × 22 × 28 = 11 × 28 = 308 cm2

\n

⇒ Area of the remaining part = Area of triangle − Area of 3 sectors

\n

⇒ Area of the remaining part = 339.08 − 308 = 31.08 cm2

\n

∴ The correct answer is 31.08 cm2.

\n

Additional Information

\n

Properties of Equilateral Triangle

\n

All three sides are equal, and all internal angles are 60°. The height is given by (√3 ÷ 2) × a.

\n

Area of a Circular Sector

\n

The area of a sector with central angle θ and radius r is given by the formula: A = (θ ÷ 360°) × πr2.

\n

Incircle and Circumcircle

\n

For an equilateral triangle of side a, the inradius r = a ÷ (2√3) and circumradius R = a ÷ √3. Their area ratio is always 1 : 4.

\n\n

समबाहु त्रिभुज की भुजा = 28 सेमी

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

समबाहु त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल = √3/4 × भुजा2

\n\n

वृत्त के त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल = θ/360 × πr2

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

\n\n

त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल जो वृत्तों में शामिल नहीं है

\n\n

⇒ समबाहु त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल - 3 × वृत्त के त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल

\n\n

⇒ √3/4 × 28 × 28 - 3 × 60/360 × 22/7 × 14 × 14

\n\n

⇒ √3 × 7 × 28 - 1/2 × 22/7 × 14 × 14

\n\n

⇒ 196√3 - 22 × 14

\n\n

⇒ 196√3 - 308

\n\n

⇒ 196 × 1.73 - 308   --(√3 = 1.73)

\n\n

⇒ 339.08 - 308

\n\n

⇒ 31.08 cm2

\n\n

अतः, सही उत्तर विकल्प (3) है।

"4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

Shortcut Trick\n

When running in the same direction, relative speed is the difference between the two speeds.

\n

Relative Speed = 13.5 − 9 = 4.5 km/h

\n

Convert to m/s: 4.5 × (5/18) = 1.25 m/s

\n

Time to meet = Track Length ÷ Relative Speed = 750 ÷ 1.25 = 600 seconds.

\n

∴ The correct answer is 600 seconds.

\n\n

Alternate Method

\n

Given:

\n

Distance of the circular track = 750 m

\n

Speed of runner X = 9 km/h

\n

Speed of runner Y = 13.5 km/h

\n

Formula Used:

\n

Time to meet for the first time = Distance ÷ Relative Speed

\n

Speed in m/s = Speed in km/h × (5/18)

\n\n\n\n

Calculations:

\n

⇒ Speed of X in m/s = 9 × (5/18) = 2.5 m/s

\n

⇒ Speed of Y in m/s = 13.5 × (5/18) = 3.75 m/s

\n

⇒ Relative speed (same direction) = Speed of Y − Speed of X

\n

⇒ Relative speed = 3.75 − 2.5 = 1.25 m/s

\n

⇒ Time to meet = 750 ÷ 1.25

\n

⇒ Time to meet = 75000 ÷ 125 = 600 seconds

\n

∴ The correct answer is 600 seconds.

\n\n

Additional Information

\n

Meeting Anywhere on the Track (Same Direction)

\n

Time to meet for the first time anywhere on the track = Track Length ÷ (S1 − S2).

\n

Meeting Anywhere on the Track (Opposite Direction)

\n

Time to meet for the first time anywhere on the track = Track Length ÷ (S1 + S2).

\n

Meeting at the Starting Point

\n

To find when runners will meet exactly at the starting point, calculate the time taken by each to complete one round, then take their LCM: LCM(T1, T2).

\n

Number of Distinct Meeting Points

\n

If the ratio of speeds is a:b (in lowest terms), the number of distinct meeting points is |a − b| for same direction, and a + b for opposite direction.

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

पुनः मिलने में लगा समय = ट्रैक की लंबाई / सापेक्ष गति

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

गति को किमी/घंटा से मी/सेकंड में बदलें:

\n\n

X की गति = 9 किमी/घंटा = 9 x (1000/3600) मीटर/सेकंड = 2.5 मीटर/सेकंड

\n\n

Y की गति = 13.5 किमी/घंटा = 13.5 x (1000/3600) मीटर/सेकंड = 3.75 मीटर/सेकंड

\n\n

एक ही दिशा में दौड़ते समय सापेक्ष गति = Y की गति - X की गति

\n\n

सापेक्ष गति = 3.75 मीटर/सेकंड - 2.5 मीटर/सेकंड = 1.25 मीटर/सेकंड

\n\n

ट्रैक की लंबाई = 750 मीटर

\n\n

पुनः मिलने में लगा समय:

\n\n

समय = ट्रैक की लंबाई / सापेक्ष गति

\n\n

⇒ समय = 750 / 1.25

\n\n

⇒ समय = 600 सेकंड

\n\n

सही उत्तर विकल्प 4: 600 सेकंड है।

      Shortcut Trick\n

      Let each 1/3 segment of the journey be the LCM of the given speeds (40, 50, and 60) = 600 km.

      \n

      Total distance of the journey = 3 × 600 = 1800 km.

      \n

      Total time taken = (600 ÷ 40) + (600 ÷ 50) + (600 ÷ 60) = 15 + 12 + 10 = 37 hours.

      \n

      Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time = 1800 ÷ 37 ≈ 48.65 km/h.

      \n

      ∴ The correct answer is 48.65 km/h.

      \n\n

      Alternate Method

      \n\n

      Given:

      \n

      The speeds for three equal segments of the journey are 40 km/h, 50 km/h, and 60 km/h.

      \n\n

      Formula Used:

      \n

      When a journey is divided into three equal parts with speeds x, y, and z, the formula for average speed is:

      \n

      Average Speed = 3xyz ÷ (xy + yz + zx)

      \n\n\n\n

      Calculations:

      \n

      ⇒ Let x = 40, y = 50, and z = 60

      \n

      ⇒ Average Speed = (3 × 40 × 50 × 60) ÷ (40 × 50 + 50 × 60 + 60 × 40)

      \n

      ⇒ Average Speed = 360000 ÷ (2000 + 3000 + 2400)

      \n

      ⇒ Average Speed = 360000 ÷ 7400

      \n

      ⇒ Average Speed = 1800 ÷ 37

      \n

      ⇒ Average Speed ≈ 48.648 km/h

      \n

      ⇒ Rounding off to two decimal places, we get 48.65 km/h.

      \n

      ∴ The correct answer is 48.65 km/h.

      \n\n

      Additional Information

      \n

      Average Speed for 2 Equal Distances

      \n

      When a body travels two equal distances at speeds x and y, the average speed over the entire journey is given by 2xy ÷ (x + y).

      \n\n

      General Average Speed Concept

      \n

      When distances are unequal, the average speed is strictly calculated by dividing the Total Distance Travelled by the Total Time Taken.

      \n\n

      Relative Speed

      \n

      If two objects move in the same direction at speeds x and y, their relative speed is |x − y|. If they move in opposite directions, their relative speed is (x + y).

      अंतिम (1)/(3) भागासाठी वेग = 60 किमी/तास.

      \n\n

      वापरलेले सूत्र:

      \n\n

      सरासरी वेग = पार केलेले एकूण अंतर / एकूण वेळ

      \n\n

      गणना:

      \n\n

      समजा एकूण अंतर d किमी आहे.

      प्रत्येक भागासाठी अंतर = d / 3

      \n\n

      पहिल्या भागासाठी लागणारा वेळ = (d / 3) / 40

      \n\n

      दुसऱ्या भागासाठी लागणारा वेळ = (d / 3) / 50

      \n\n

      तिसऱ्या भागासाठी लागणारा वेळ = (d / 3) / 60

      \n\n

      एकूण अंतर = d

      \n\n

      एकूण अंतर = (d / 3 × 1/40) + (d / 3 × 1/50) + (d / 3 × 1/60)

      \n\n

      एकूण अंतर = d/3 (1/40 + 1/50 + 1/60)

      \n\n

      एकूण अंतर = d/3 (0.025 + 0.02 + 0.01667)

      एकूण अंतर = d × 0.02056

      सरासरी वेग = d / (d × 0.02056)

      सरासरी वेग = 1 / 0.02056

      \n\n

      सरासरी वेग = 48.65 किमी/तास

      পরবর্তী (1)/(3) এর জন্য গতি = 50 কিমি/ঘন্টা।

      \n\n

      চূড়ান্ত (1)/(3) এর জন্য গতি = 60 কিমি/ঘন্টা 11 3দূরত্ব = 60 কিমি/ঘন্টা।

      \n\n

      সূত্র ব্যবহৃত:

      \n\n

      গড় গতি = মোট দূরত্ব ভ্রমণ / মোট সময়

      \n\n

      গণনা:

      \n\n

      মোট দূরত্ব d কিমি ধরা যাক।

      \n\n

      প্রতিটি অংশের দূরত্ব = d/3

      \n\n

      প্রথম অংশের জন্য নেওয়া সময় = (d/3)/40

      \n\n

      দ্বিতীয় অংশের জন্য নেওয়া সময় = (d/3)/50

      \n\n

      তৃতীয় অংশের জন্য নেওয়া সময় = (d/3)/60

      \n\n

      মোট দূরত্ব = d

      \n\n

      মোট সময় = (d / 3 × 1/40) + (d / 3 × 1/50) + (d / 3 × 1/60)

      \n\n

      মোট সময় = d/3 (1/40 + 1/50 + 1/60)

      \n\n

      মোট সময় = d/3 (0.025 + 0.02 + 0.01667)

      \n\n

      মোট সময় = d/3 (0.06167)

      \n\n

      মোট সময় = d × 0.02056

      \n\n

      গড় গতি = d / (d × 0.02056)

      \n\n

      গড় গতি = 1 / 0.02056

      \n\n

      গড় গতি = 48.65 কিমি/ঘন্টা

      \n\n

      পুরো যাত্রার জন্য বাসের গড় গতি 48.65 কিমি/ঘন্টা।

        Shortcut Trick\n

        Total capacity of the cistern = LCM(40, 80, 120) = 240 units.

        \n

        Efficiency of P = 6, Q = 3, and R = 2 units/min.

        \n

        Since P works for the entire 30 minutes, work done by P = 30 × 6 = 180 units.

        \n

        Remaining work to be done by Q and R together = 240 − 180 = 60 units.

        \n

        Time pipes Q and R were open = 60 ÷ (3 + 2) = 12 minutes.

        \n

        ∴ The correct answer is 12 minutes.

        \n\n

        Alternate Method

        \n

        Given:

        \n

        Time taken by P = 40 minutes

        \n

        Time taken by Q = 80 minutes

        \n

        Time taken by R = 120 minutes

        \n

        Total time to fill the cistern = 30 minutes (half an hour)

        \n\n\n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n \n
        PipeMinutesTotal WorkEfficiency
        P402406
        Q803
        R1202
        \n\n

        Calculations:

        \n

        ⇒ The cistern is filled in exactly 30 minutes, which means pipe P was kept open for the entire duration of 30 minutes.

        \n

        ⇒ Work done by pipe P alone in 30 minutes = Efficiency × Time = 6 × 30 = 180 units.

        \n

        ⇒ Total work remaining = Total capacity − Work done by P

        \n

        ⇒ Remaining work = 240 − 180 = 60 units.

        \n

        ⇒ This remaining work must have been completed by pipes Q and R before they were turned off.

        \n

        ⇒ Combined efficiency of pipes Q and R = 3 + 2 = 5 units/min.

        \n

        ⇒ Time for which Q and R were kept open = Remaining work ÷ Combined efficiency

        \n

        ⇒ Time = 60 ÷ 5 = 12 minutes.

        \n

        ∴ The correct answer is 12 minutes.

        \n\n

        Additional Information

        \n

        Emptying Pipes (Negative Work)

        \n

        If a pipe or a leak empties a tank, its efficiency is considered negative. The net filling efficiency becomes (Sum of inlet efficiencies) − (Sum of outlet efficiencies).

        \n

        Time and Efficiency Relation

        \n

        Time taken is always inversely proportional to efficiency. The ratio of time taken by two pipes A and B to fill a tank is the exact inverse of their efficiency ratio.

        \n

        Pipes Working on Alternate Minutes

        \n

        When pipes operate alternately, calculate the net work done in a complete cycle (e.g., 2 minutes or 3 minutes). Find out how many such cycles fit into the total work and manually add the remaining efforts for the last fractions.

        दिया गया है:

        \n\n

        पाइप P टंकी को 40 मिनट में भर सकता है।

        \n\n

        पाइप Q टंकी को 80 मिनट में भर सकता है।

        \n\n

        पाइप R टंकी को 120 मिनट में भर सकता है।

        \n\n

        सभी पाइप प्रारंभ में खुले हैं और टंकी को 30 मिनट में भरने की आवश्यकता है।

        \n\n

        गणना:

        \n\n

        टंकी की कुल क्षमता = 40, 80 और 120 का LCM

        \n\n

        ⇒ 240

        \n\n

        प्रति मिनट पाइप P की क्षमता = 240/40 = 6

        \n\n

        Shortcut Trick\n

        Using the direct formula: a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = [(a + b + c) ÷ 2] × [3(a2 + b2 + c2) − (a + b + c)2]

        \n

        Substitute the given values: Sum = 18, Sum of squares = 36

        \n

        ⇒ Required value = (18 ÷ 2) × [3 × 36 − 182]

        \n

        ⇒ Required value = 9 × [108 − 324] = 9 × (−216) = −1944

        \n

        ∴ The correct answer is −1944.

        \n\n

        Alternate Method

        \n

        Given:

        \n

        Sum of three numbers, a + b + c = 18

        \n

        Sum of their squares, a2 + b2 + c2 = 36

        \n

        Formula Used:

        \n

        (a + b + c)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

        \n

        a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = (a + b + c) × [a2 + b2 + c2 − (ab + bc + ca)]

        \n

        Calculation:

        \n

        ⇒ (18)2 = 36 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

        \n

        ⇒ 324 − 36 = 2(ab + bc + ca)

        \n

        ⇒ 288 = 2(ab + bc + ca)

        \n

        ⇒ ab + bc + ca = 144

        \n

        Now, substitute the values into the second formula:

        \n

        ⇒ a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = 18 × [36 − 144]

        \n

        ⇒ a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = 18 × (−108)

        \n

        ⇒ a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = −1944

        \n

        ∴ The correct answer is −1944.

        \n\n

        Additional Information

        \n

        Alternative Algebraic Identity

        \n

        a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = [(a + b + c) ÷ 2] × [(a − b)2 + (b − c)2 + (c − a)2].

        \n

        Special Conditional Case

        \n

        If the sum of the variables a + b + c = 0, then the identity reduces to a3 + b3 + c3 = 3abc. This property is frequently tested in competitive exams.

        \n

        Square of a Trinomial

        \n

        (a + b + c)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2(ab + bc + ca). It helps in finding the sum of the product of variables taken two at a time.

        ఇచ్చినది:

        \n\n

        x + y + z = 18

        \n\n

        x2 + y2 + z2 = 36

        \n\n

        ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

        \n\n

        x3 + y3 + z3 - 3xyz = (x + y + z) x [(x + y + z)2 - 3(xy + yz + zx)]

        \n\n

        లెక్కలు:

        \n\n

        ఇచ్చిన దాని నుండి, x + y + z = 18 మరియు x2 + y2 + z2 = 36

        \n\n

        గుర్తింపును ఉపయోగించి: x2দেওয়া আছে:

        \n\n

        x + y + z = 18

        \n\n

        x2 + y2 + z2 = 36

        \n\n

        ব্যবহৃত সূত্র:

        \n\n

        x3 + y3 + z3 - 3xyz = (x + y + z) x [(x + y + z)2 - 3(xy + yz + zx)]

        \n\n

        গণনা:

        \n\n

        প্রশ্নানুসারে, x + y + z = 18 এবং x2 + y2 + z2 = 36

        \n\n

        আমরা জানি, x2 + y2 + z2= (x + y + z)2 - 2(xy + yz + zx)

        \n\n

        সুতরাং, 36 = (18)2 - 2(xy + yz + zx)

        \n\n

        36 = 324 - 2(xy + yz + zx)

        \n\n

        2(xy + yz + zx) = 324 - 36 = 288

        \n\n

        xy + yz + zx = 144

        \n\n

        এখন মূল সমীকরণে মান বসিয়ে পাই,

        \n\n

        ×3 + y3 + z3 - 3×yz = (18) × [(18)2 - 3(144)]

        \n\n

        ×3 + y3 + z3 - 3×yz = 18 × [324 - 432]

        \n\n

        ×3 + y3 + z3 - 3×yz = 18 × (-108)

        \n\n

        ×3 + y3 + z3 - 3×yz = -1944

        \n\n

        উত্তর:

        তাদের ঘনকের যোগফল এবং তাদের গুণফলের তিনগুণের মধ্যে পার্থক্য হল -1944।

        \nHe tried to alleviate the sufferings of his neighbours.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Swell"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Add"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Intensify"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Relieve"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

        The correct answer is: Option 4.

        \n\n
          \n\t

            \n\t\t
          • Example: He took painkillers to alleviate his headache.

          \n\t

        • "Relieve" means to cause (pain, distress, or difficulty) to become less severe or serious. (राहत देना)\n\t

        Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

        \nThe contract was grabbed by the biggest telecom company in India.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "The biggest telecom company in India grabbed the contract."}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "The biggest telecom company in India grabs the contract."}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "The biggest telecom company in India will grab the contract."}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "The biggest telecom company in India has grabbed the contract."}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

        The correct answer is Option 1.
        \n\n
         
        \n\n
        Key Points
        \n\n
          \n\t
        • The given sentence is in the passive voice and needs to be converted to the active voice.
          • \n\t
        • In the passive voice, the subject receives the action, whereas, in the active voice, the subject performs the action.
          • \n\t
        • The correct active voice sentence should identify the doer of the action first, followed by the action itself.
          • \n\t
        • Thus, the correct active voice sentence is: "The biggest telecom company in India grabbed the contract."
          • \n
        \n\n
        Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.
        \n\n
         
        \n\n
        Correct Sentence: "The biggest telecom company in India grabbed the contract."
        \n\n
         
        \n\n
        Additional Information
        \n\n
          \n\t
        • Option 2: "The biggest telecom company in India grabs the contract." – This is in the present tense, while the original sentence is in the past tense.
          • \n\t
        • Option 3: "The biggest telecom company in India will grab the contract." – This is in the future tense, which does not match the original sentence's past tense.

        \nBy whom was grammar taught to you?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Did he teach you grammar?"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Who had taught you grammar?"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "You were taught grammar by whom?"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Who taught you grammar?"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

        The correct answer is Option 4.
        \n\n
         
        \n\n
        Key Points
        \n\n
          \n\t
        • The given sentence "By whom was grammar taught to you?" is in the passive voice.
          • \n\t
        • To express it in the active voice, we need to identify the subject performing the action (who) and place it at the beginning of the sentence.
          • \n\t
        • The structure in active voice would be "Who taught you grammar?"
          • \n\t
        • In this construction, "who" is the subject, "taught" is the verb, and "you" is the object.
          • \n
        \n\n
        Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.
        \n\n
         
        \n\n
        Correct Sentence: "Who taught you grammar?"
        \n\n
         
        \n\n
        Additional Information
        \n\n
          \n\t
        • Option 1: "Did he teach you grammar?" - This is a yes/no question but does not use the correct subject "who" or the correct structure.
          • \n\t
        • Option 2: "Who had taught you grammar?" - Incorrect tense (past perfect instead of simple past).
          • \n\t
        • Option 3: "You were taught grammar by whom?" - This is in the passive voice and merely rephrases the original question without changing the voice.
          • \n
